mentions.name: Progress 8 school data toolkit
mentions.description: This data toolkit takes in a CSV of pupil results and outputs Attainment 8 and Progress 8 results for UK secondary schools. The next step is wrapping it into a web app with further analysis, such as showing the Marginal Contribution of each subject.
mentions.problem: There is no tool available to perform the DfE's Progress 8 calculations, so schools work from complex spreadsheets or wait for the DfE's league table announcements, and existing spreadsheet approaches are hard to use and slow to tweak.
mentions.audience: UK secondary schools and school performance leaders in Multi-Academy Trusts.
mentions.source_excerpt: I put together a prototype project which would take in a csv of pupil results and spit out all the Attainment 8 and Progress 8 results. The next step is to wrap it up into a nice web app, and do further analysis. I'd like a school to be able to see things like the Marginal Contribution of each subject and such.
